messages:
customer_jamie: Hey team — I just tried to apply the promo code WELCOME2026 via the REST API and got an error: 400 {"error":"code_expired"}. The code shows as active in the dashboard. Email: jamie@example.com, org: org_12345. Can someone check?

support_lee: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact curl you used (headers + body) and the full API response body? Also when did you try (UTC)?

customer_jamie: Here you go — tried at 2026-03-16T09:12:30+13:00 (NZDT).
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/promos/redeem \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-XXXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"org_id":"org_12345","code":"WELCOME2026"}'
```
API response: 400 Bad Request
{
  "error": "code_expired",
  "message": "This promo code has expired and cannot be redeemed"
}

support_lee: thanks — pinging @eng-kim and @billing_oliver to investigate. I can also escalate to manual credit if this is a bug.

eng-kim: looking. Can you share promo internal id from the dashboard URL or the promo slug? I want to check the grant window and the redemption log.

support_lee: dashboard link: https://app.redwood.example.com/promos/PR-98765 (internal id PR-98765).

eng-kim: quick check in redeem_logs shows: redeem_attempt at 2026-03-16T - 2026-03-16T - user tried at 2026-03-16T09:12:30+13:00 (matches). Promo PR-98765 expiry_ts in DB = 2026-03-15T23:59:59Z. 
That looks like the expiry was set to 2026-03-15 midnight UTC. For a NZDT user that is already 2026-03-16 morning -> appears expired.

billing_oliver: confirmed. The campaign team created the promo with expiry = 2026-03-15 23:59:59 UTC (intended). The copy on the marketing page said "valid through Mar 16 (local)" which caused confusion. Not a DB bug, but mismatch between message and expectation.

support_lee: Jamie, sorry for the confusion — the code expired at 2026-03-15 23:59:59 UTC, which is why your attempt on 2026-03-16 NZDT failed. We can either: 1) issue a one-time manual credit for your org, or 2) re-open the promo window and reissue the code (requires a campaign change). Which do you prefer? :thinking_face:

customer_jamie: Manual credit would be great, thanks. We missed the UTC cutoff.

billing_oliver: I'll create a manual grant for org_12345 for the equivalent amount. Creating now.

deploy-bot: [audit] manual_credit.created id MC-20260316-001 by billing_oliver for org_12345 amount 50.00 USD

billing_oliver: Done — manual credit MC-20260316-001 applied. Please verify on your end, Jamie.

customer_jamie: I see the credit in the billing page, and it applied to the pending invoice. Thanks! :white_check_mark:

support_lee: closing loop — logged follow-up with campaigns to fix website wording and add region-aware examples to promo copy. Ticket: INT-4521. If you'd like reissued code instead, LMK.

customer_jamie: No need, credit is perfect. Appreciate the quick help.

support_lee: glad it's sorted. Closing thread. :tada:
